description: My Unforgettable Juneteenth Moment at the U.S. Supreme CourtI never imagined this moment—not as a boy chopping cotton in the Mississippi Delta, and not as a young soldier fighting in Iraq.But this morning, during Juneteenth week, I walked up the storied steps of the United States Supreme Court.The marble was gleaming.
